# A-MAZE-ING - Graeme V. Samways - DREAMER 13 pp.9-10 (PDF pp.11-12)
# load 0080-03FF (printed 0080-00FF and 0200-02FF on p.9, 0300-03FF on p.10; 0100-01FF is the
# display RAM); needs 2K: 0400-05FF is workspace for the 'dead-end' data. run C000 FN 3
# how to play: draw a maze moving the cursor: 4 up-left, 5 up, 6 up-right, 8 left, A right,
# C down-left, D down, E down-right; key 2 sets/erases the square under the cursor; key 0 drops
# food (any number of times, or none); put the cursor at the maze entrance and press 1 to set the
# mouse free. Hold 3 to interrupt the search (until it bleeps). When the mouse finds the food and
# bleeps, hold 7 until the tone changes; then B = same maze again, F = erase and start again.
# Reading notes: in the scan the last digit of several key words in 024A-0278 (the 480N tests after
# F80A) is overwritten by hand-written marks of a reader; the digits used follow the key table of
# the article (C=down-left, D=down, E=down-right, 8=left, A=right, 4=up-left, 5=up, 6=up-right),
# which is also what the paired moves 7Axx/7Bxx require. 03FE printed faintly '13E?': read 13E2.
